_meta.title: Clash Front PentaPet domains + combat rings
_meta.author: Map-maker session, 2026-07-07 (owner-locked)
_meta.note: 7 nature DOMAINS group the 17 pet species. A Master commands a domain (buffs all its elements). Domains overlay the zone/region maps — they do not change which species live where.
_meta.combatRule: In a triangle [A,B,C]: A beats B, B beats C, C beats A. Beast is the neutral baseline (no advantage/weakness). Light>Shadow is the marquee; it maps onto the sky(Light)<->underworld(Shadow) world axis.
